mentions.name: Who Is Hiring Discussion Board
mentions.description: This app is a discussion board for HN's 'Who is hiring' listings, letting job seekers discuss and flag companies whose postings are scams, self-promotion, or a waste of time. It currently has a beta tester list people can join by email.
mentions.problem: Job applicants get burned by scam listings and by companies that use job seekers as a marketing channel, while HN refuses to allow threaded discussions and removes such comments.
mentions.audience: People applying to jobs through HN's Who is hiring threads
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working on a discussion board for HN’s Who is hiring.
mentions.author: newbie578
